scenes.title: Review readiness
scenes.narration: Check delivery requirements, resources, unresolved controls, access and specialist-review needs. A written mitigation is not proof of safety. Unresolved blockers can require iteration or pause.

scenes.title: Choose a next move
scenes.narration: Proceed means a defined next bounded step with conditions, not blanket launch approval. Iterate means revise or gather missing evidence. Pause means stop dependent work until blockers or priorities change. All three are valid reasoned outcomes.

scenes.title: Record and hand off
scenes.narration: Create your Validate Decision Record, with reasons, limits, conditions, next owner and review timing. Learning completion does not verify sources or approve the venture.

sections.label: 02 / LEARN
sections.heading: Proceed, iterate and pause are all valid outcomes.

children: Make a reasoned proceed, iterate or pause decision within the evidence and readiness limits. Learning completion is separate from approval to build, launch, collect money or claim demand.
Define the offer/version and review scope.
Reference the learning pack manually; preserve source status.
Summarise evidence, contradictions and remaining unknowns.
Review readiness, controls, owners and blockers.
Record a reasoned next move with conditions and stop triggers.
Assign bounded next work and a review date.
Proceed
A defined next bounded step with conditions. It does not automatically permit launch, spending, payments or production data collection.
Iterate
Revise the offer/assumptions or gather missing/conflicting evidence; define a fresh check.
Pause
Stop dependent work while access, safeguards, resources or priorities remain unresolved. Record what could reopen review.
Unknown remains honest
Planned/rehearsal sources do not validate customer claims. Do not invent findings to make the review look complete.
Illustrative planned review

Only a concept and planned/rehearsal research exist; access is pending. Customer demand/payment remain unknown. A reasoned choice is iterate for missing evidence, or pause dependent outreach until permission is resolved. Record owner and next review; no launch approval exists.

Keep technical, privacy, legal, commercial and other specialist reviews separate where the actual venture requires them. Source verification and venture approval are human responsibilities; worksheet completion cannot provide them. Use anonymous summaries only in local plaintext storage.
